lifecycle.activation_rule: Replace only the manifest blocked command with the dedicated real runner/config after #556 approves one named fungal pack and #615 exposes authoritative fungal state/checkpoint/events/metrics. Preserve this stable experiment id and evidence contract.

forbidden_sources: renderer hyphae or paths as growth authority
E. coli model-resource relabelled as physical glucose without a reviewed bridge
unsourced bacteria-fungus attack or cooperation coefficients
explicitly_not_claimed: whole-system biological validation from replay correctness alone
cross-species interaction validity unless separately enabled by sourced authority

deterministic_workload_contract.seed_set_policy: The activated runner must commit a small explicit fixed seed list in source before evidence is collected; seeds are engineering replay inputs, not fitted biological parameters.

controls.requirement: Use the authoritative pack/resource contract to establish a true zero-resource or equivalent no-growth input; assert no source-incompatible biomass production.
Disable the named pack's growth mechanism through an explicit supported control and assert no growth-state advance.
Same seed + same accepted commands must reproduce checkpoint/event/metric identity exactly.
Checkpoint restore plus suffix continuation must reproduce the uninterrupted authoritative result.

optional_controls_after_authority_exists.requirement: Run only when a named bacterial competitor and a reviewed shared-resource compatibility contract exist; otherwise omit rather than synthesize interaction.

deterministic_workload_contract.source_validation_targets: Only target quantities explicitly approved by #556 with exact strain/background, medium/substrate, temperature, culture format, unit, source key, and validity envelope. Unapproved radial/branching/resource quantities remain absent, not zero-filled.

source_validation.rule: No item may exist unless the target is explicitly approved by #556; model-contract checks and source-context validation must remain distinguishable.

resumability.requirement: Use authoritative checkpoints plus a stable run/resume identity; resume must not alter seed, pack/config identity, horizon, sampling cadence, or already accepted prefix.
